About

Researcher who codes.
Developer who investigates.

I'm experienced in tech, research, and administration — including supporting a UCSF epidemiology team during COVID-19, where I contributed to public health data tracking, code transcription, and scientific writing. I was nominated alongside my colleagues for a COVID-19 Data Hero Award in 2021.

As an independent contractor, I've provided technical support, account management, coding support, and research for clients ranging from solopreneurs to UC San Francisco and Google. I also have experience at Amazon in Seller Support and Customer Support, working across B2C and B2B clients and cross-functional teams.

More recently, I've been building hands-on with AI — helming coding and pair coding with Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gemini to create working tools, automations, and documented workflows. I'm channeling this into frontend development and AI-assisted problem-solving: building things that are as well-researched as they are well-designed.
